answer: In PoA, EigenTrust matrix factorization updates a reciprocity-weighted trust matrix, while reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life. Sustained honest service is therefore required to retain eigenvector centrality; a freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero centrality, and isolated links—whether labeled ember, violet, or onyx—cannot accumulate sufficient trusted mass to pass consensus before transient gains decay.
